warnings.why: New Caledonia is an overseas collectivity of France, not a sovereign country with its own independent World Bank terrestrial protected area series of this scale, though its marine reserves are massive, terrestrial coverage is often conflated or reported via France.

Turks and Caicos is a British Overseas Territory, and small island territories frequently experience data anomalies in World Bank land area series due to small denominators and confusion between terrestrial and marine protected areas.

policy: model memory is advisory; unsupported suspicions cannot overrule official data
